description: Get a user's check-in stats at a specific venue — visit count, last visit, average rating, top beers — by scanning their recent check-in feed (1 API call per 25 check-ins scanned; the stats cover the scanned window, not all time)

max_pages.description: Max feed pages to scan at 25 check-ins/page (default 5 = 125 check-ins)

username.description: Untappd username (defaults to UNTAPPD_USERNAME env var)

name: get_user_stats_at_venue
